label: prop:tri
title: Tri-region partition and finite-session resolution floor
review_note: Useful distinction between time, quantity and funding. Pulse-cycle independence/reset and session restrictions must remain explicit; a design-class floor is not an unrestricted optimum.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:spectral
title: Spectral dissipation lower bound
review_note: The money-information bridge is economically valuable. Parseval argument is coherent under the stated execution law. Distinguish trading loss, fees, initial margin and capital. Enclose the continuous frequency optimum before calling decimal brackets certified.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:adaptive
title: Adaptive and sequential probing
review_note: Separates expected sequential trading loss from capital needed to survive a random stopping time. Preserve finite-energy/integrability assumptions and do not market an expected-loss improvement as a solvency guarantee.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:rh
title: Finite-horizon Rayleigh--H\"older duality
review_note: The fee-aware finite-horizon bound is more distinctive than another scaling plot. Check generalized-eigenvalue multiplicities and sign changes, and certify angular minimization rather than relying on a finite grid.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: cor:garch
title: Invariance under impact-induced heteroskedasticity
review_note: Variance/slippage specifications are assumed and perturbative. State uniformity ranges for the big-O constant; this is not robustness to arbitrary endogenous heteroskedasticity.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:abstain
title: Finite-window abstention
review_note: Two-world testing yields an abstention requirement. Distinguish unconditional error from error conditional on issuing a label. Boundary and finite-window scope matter.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:passive0
title: Passive distinction with zero controlled quantity
review_note: Natural excitation can substitute time for controlled quantity in the reset-block experiment. Zero probing cost is not zero elapsed time or a universal zero-cost surveillance result.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:tagged
title: Tagged flow removes the barrier
review_note: Class-specific observations remove mixture competition. Its excitation, instrument relevance and observation precision are essential. Public position ratios are not tagged executed flow.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:discvalue
title: Value of class-tagged disclosure
review_note: The sample-saving ratio gives a concrete value of information under matched precision and targets. It is not the welfare benefit of an audit trail or a claim that every disclosure is cost-effective.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:blind
title: Spectral blindness
review_note: The construction separates spectral/variance summaries from an arbitrary-state shock gain. Hidden-shock variance changes with coupling; standardizing the shock set can change the interpretation. Do not infer empirical crash-prediction failure from this alone.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: lem:micro
title: Filtering and learning microfoundations
review_note: Filtering and gradient algebra explain exponential updating. They do not derive a rational-expectations price signal or the profitability of continuation demand. The trader objective and beliefs need their own economic justification.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

title: Why exponential memory
review_note: The quadratic trading objective yields an interior rule; inventory constraints can bind. Describe this as an individual best response under specified beliefs, not a complete equilibrium.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: lem:cm
title: Positive price-response geometry
review_note: Positive diagonal symmetrization produces nonnegative decaying modes. This restricts the baseline: its flow impulse does not overshoot. Preserve price-first timing and positivity when reusing the result.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:merged
title: Merged rate--weight equivalence
review_note: Equal transfer functions recover only the merged measure with known primitives and the stated observation contract. Exact nonidentification applies to cohort decomposition; distinct rates are identifiable in principle. Keep the a=0 dimension exception.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: rem:scope
title: Scope
review_note: Correctly limits the theorem to the model and distinguishes identities, wealth allocations, shared rates and nearby distinguishable rates. Preserve this language in abstracts.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:quantity
title: Sharp probing-resource orders for a known symmetric pair
review_note: Known symmetric pair, deterministic common probes and Gaussian observation noise support sharp quantity scaling and pulse attainment. This is not an unknown-mixture estimator or a result about arbitrary production algorithms.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: lem:toeplitz
title: Fair execution
review_note: Average linear-book execution gives the Toeplitz cost and positive round-trip dissipation in the positive class. Explain who supplies this schedule and what changes under nonlinear impact or signed kernels.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:cap
title: Sharp robust quantity cap from cash and margin
review_note: Robust cap is for all nonnegative probes against a designated account in the noiseless-state model. A positive pulse attains the adverse bound. Do not transfer its constants to an unconstrained live order book.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:disclosure
title: Exact financial disclosure changes the experiment
review_note: Exact equity reveals a noiseless state channel. This is an intentionally idealized disclosure result; rounding, marking rules and reporting error determine practical value.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:capital
title: Time-domain Toeplitz coercivity: capital order for funded probes
review_note: A solvent-account energy bound supports the fourth-power order. The explicit constant is acknowledged to be very loose. Lead with the stronger spectral account analysis rather than this bound.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:primitives
title: Identification in economic primitives
review_note: Reexpressing rates as information quality and intensities as benefit/cost ratios directly answers a microstructure objection. It inherits the statistical rates; derive the perceived continuation opportunity and relate the learning signal to observables.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:tied
title: Intensity tied to information quality
audit_judgment: Revised in this branch; independent review still required
review_note: Unknown type masses preserve the mixture class even if information quality determines intensity. Treat real-valued n_i as masses, not integer desk counts. C2 smoothness supports o(delta^2), not the displayed O(delta^4) Taylor remainder. Brouwer assumes rather than derives the belief map.
revision_status: See RESEARCH_PLAN P0; previous audit note retained as history

label: prop:crb
title: Cram\'er--Rao benchmark
review_note: Fisher conditioning is informative. A variance lower bound alone is not a universal finite-sample fixed-coverage interval lower bound; label the normal/regular benchmark. The global two-point theorem carries the unrestricted-estimator claim.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:twocohort
title: Global two-point bound and matching upper bound, K=2
audit_judgment: Core rate result / loss definition essential
review_note: Moment-matched alternatives separate rate-ordered weights. Permutation-invariant parameter loss needs the stated spacing threshold. Close rates make uniform weight recovery fail; do not equate this with inability to recover aggregate risk.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: rem:riskneutral
title: The hard directions carry no risk
review_note: The hardest constructed pairs share total feedback and the summed response. This is the sharpest intuitive link between identification and decision costs. It is a property of those hard directions, not every unidentified economic risk.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:kcohort
title: K-cohort two-point lower bound
review_note: Positive quadrature gives high-order indistinguishability and the familiar mixture exponent. State the loss, shrinking local class, total mass and K-dependent constants. Novelty lies in the closed-loop/financial connection rather than the exponent alone.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:esprit
title: Matching upper bound for every K
audit_judgment: Revised in this branch; independent review still required
review_note: Compact separated-node inversion plausibly matches the rate. Estimated deconvolved moments are not exactly Gaussian after nonlinear inversion; replace that sentence with a high-probability smooth-map argument. Matching requires a class containing the lower-bound pair.
revision_status: See RESEARCH_PLAN P0; previous audit note retained as history

label: thm:uniformw1
title: Uniform rate without separation
review_note: Recovers the merged distribution without rate separation or positive individual-weight floors. It inherits a moment-comparison inequality and needs positive total mass. This is stronger economically than simply declaring close cohorts unidentifiable.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: lem:altpair
title: Moment-matched cohort pairs
review_note: Alternation and divided differences construct finite positive measures with matched moments and Wasserstein separation. Verify support counts, normalization and the approximation constant independently.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:general
title: Minimax rate for general memory
review_note: Logarithmic recovery is a substantial extension beyond fixed K. Distinguish the infinite-order class from a fixed finite parametric model. Track inversion error and constants as memory approaches one; do not overread finite simulation slopes.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:minphase
title: Passive identification: minimum phase
audit_judgment: Revised in this branch; independent review still required
review_note: The displayed H has a structural zero at z=0 when a>0, in addition to the memory zeros. The minimum-phase conclusion can survive, but the phrase exactly the memory rates needs the timing-zero exception and cancellation cases.
revision_status: See RESEARCH_PLAN P0; previous audit note retained as history

label: prop:passive
title: Passive cost
review_note: Single-innovation Gaussian spectral experiments inherit the high-order information gap. Multiple shock channels, endogenous flow and changing parameters alter that experiment. Similar polynomial order does not imply identical money/time costs.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:probe
title: Anytime-valid probing
review_note: A time-uniform confidence event permits optional stopping. The deterministic implication is separate from the martingale/concentration theorem and the independence or sub-Gaussian contract.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:disclosure
title: Decision value of disclosure
review_note: Nested exact compatible sets improve robust capacity. Strictness requires exclusion with a genuine gap/attained maximum. More information cannot hurt an optimal decision maker who may ignore it; the noisy-proxy loss concerns a particular plug-in procedure.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:equil
title: Equilibrium transient risk
review_note: Private/public exposure shares impose a standard externality wedge. The loss Lambda*S is posited, not derived from a full shock-and-utility model. Endogenous-depth part was added after seeing data; comparative statics require what is held fixed.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:guard
title: Summed-gain guard is maximal
audit_judgment: Correct classical identity / not standalone novelty
review_note: Summed absolute response is the induced bounded-input gain. Maximality is exact for fixed inventory and the declared shock set. It is not a global optimal trading policy or a distributional ruin guarantee.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: lem:tail
title: Contraction-block tail bound
review_note: Block contraction yields a rigorous remainder if norms are certified. Keep state-row gains distinct from monetary input-output gains, and include input scaling when converting the bound.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:robust
title: Robust gain
review_note: The perturbation proof is coherent for a fixed norm and epsilon*S<1. It controls a peak state gain; a cumulative-gain guarantee needs its own bound. Feasibility can be rare at estimated uncertainty.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: lem:sound
title: Soundness of compatible-set guards
review_note: A simultaneous model coverage event protects data-selected actions. This is stronger than separate pointwise intervals for each candidate action.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:robustguard
title: Optimal uncertainty-aware admission
review_note: Closed-form maximality follows under proportional feedback admission, fixed exogenous shocks and reset/observed drift. The endpoint must be attainable for information-relative maximality. Zero-feedback and budget-equality edge cases need explicit conventions.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:venue
title: Venue mode
review_note: Admission that supplies both feedback and liquidity can create disconnected safe sets. The quadratic construction is illustrative, not an equilibrium. Sign/domain restrictions must ensure that the risk formula corresponds to a stable operator.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:venuebb
title: Certified admission without monotonicity
review_note: Interval branch-and-bound can certify the full safe set. Outward enclosures, tails, all unexamined boxes, continuity and uniform stability are obligations; sampled grid agreement alone is not certification.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:forward
title: Conditional bounded-shock forward solvency
audit_judgment: Revised in this branch; independent review still required
review_note: Check cash, mark changes, margin, fill cash and hedge costs under one timing convention. The triangle bound generally gives sufficiency; necessity at rest requires joint attainability of the inventory and shock scenarios.
revision_status: See RESEARCH_PLAN P0; previous audit note retained as history

label: prop:driftguard
title: Uniformly safe guard under interval-bounded unknown hidden drift
audit_judgment: Revised in this branch; independent review still required
review_note: Its cumulative-drift formula omits q_i/eta_i under the stated coordinates. A stable single cohort yields 5 rather than 0.5. Its claimed exact maximum 0.24 is refuted by a uniform invariant-box proof admitting 0.30 in its own calibration.
revision_status: See RESEARCH_PLAN P0; previous audit note retained as history

label: prop:dominance
title: When an eigenvalue rule admits an uncertified level
review_note: Failure of a sufficient certificate means uncertified, not necessarily unsafe. A spectral-only comparator is weaker than realistic inventory/volatility limits; keep the proposition subordinate.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:lucas
title: Strategic re-optimization reinforces the guard
review_note: The renewal coupling establishes finite-horizon monotonicity in adaptation under positive feedback. It does not prove arbitrary strategic agents reinforce the guard; q and beliefs can change too, and the book extension is numerical/conditional.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: ex:witness
title: An exact ambiguity witness
review_note: Exact rational early-response agreement with distinct total risk illustrates decision ambiguity. It should appear near the main economic question rather than deep in technical sections.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:twoworld
title: Unavoidable loss of safe capacity
review_note: The TV argument is short and coherent. Its economic value is the loss of safe participation; connect that capacity to a real objective before calling it social welfare.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:window
title: Finite-window certification
audit_judgment: Revised in this branch; independent review still required
review_note: Moment-extremal bounds are useful. State existence of a stable compatible economy. An infinite upper endpoint is a supremum, not attained by a stable finite-gain economy. Odd/even moment-cone localization details need explicit formulation.
revision_status: See RESEARCH_PLAN P0; previous audit note retained as history

label: lem:certnum
title: Certified endpoints
review_note: Polynomial envelopes plus outward arithmetic can certify extremal integrals. Verify every sign and rounding stage; a high-precision optimizer alone does not prove an endpoint.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:certcost
title: Certification cost of the summed response
audit_judgment: Revised in this branch; independent review still required
review_note: The upper certificate and the one-log lower bound separate risk from identity costs. State known stability/memory envelopes, experiment horizon and independent reset assumptions. Correct part-number cross-references in the explanation and appendix.
revision_status: See RESEARCH_PLAN P0; previous audit note retained as history

label: rem:cheb
title: Shorter windows cost more experiments
review_note: A shorter exact-data window can be much worse under noisy monomial moments. This gives an honest precision/horizon tradeoff rather than an unqualified cheap-certification claim.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:hotelling
title: Certification with unknown covariance
review_note: Student sums and Hotelling give valid Gaussian-reset procedures. Positive definite covariance, independent episodes and N>T matter. Empirical block-bootstrap intervals are not these certificates.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:peak
title: Peak overshoot: depletion versus momentum
review_note: Two-state depletion iff condition is coherent; momentum extension is only sufficient at one step. Avoid the broader false statement that non-normality is necessary for every scalar-output impulse overshoot.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: rem:counter
title: Counterexamples to an exact one-period condition
audit_judgment: Useful limits of the simple rule
review_note: The delayed overshoot examples show why a first-lag diagnostic is not exact with extra modes. They support retaining the full response rather than overinterpreting C3.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:sum
title: Summed response in closed form
review_note: The signed sum follows from the stationary resolvent. Equality with worst-case risk requires nonnegative impulse coefficients; a positive signed denominator alone does not establish all forms of stability.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:jury
title: Stability with one cohort
review_note: Jury conditions provide an exact one-cohort check. Explain the maintained a>=0 restriction and when thin-depth oscillatory constraints are redundant or active.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:invariance
title: Input--output invariance
review_note: Input-output coefficients are cohort/coordinate invariant; latent Euclidean state gains are not. This is the right basis for economic risk comparisons.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:inventory_S
title: Summed response with carried cohort inventory
audit_judgment: Revised in this branch; independent review still required
review_note: Inventory payback attenuates the zero-frequency feedback. The signed sum is not the absolute gain after sign reversal. This is a meaningful response to the objection that momentum desks cannot hold inventory forever.
revision_status: See RESEARCH_PLAN P0; previous audit note retained as history

label: prop:ambig
title: Quote cost of ambiguity
review_note: The robust quote depends on the worst relevant cost, not hidden identity by itself. Define whether the surplus calculation is total surplus and keep it separate from the pre-trade safety objective.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:radius
title: Safe radius, Kreiss bounds and the failure of the spectral radius
review_note: The operator-norm radius is correct for a fixed shock ball and output. Kreiss comparison is for C=I and fixed coordinates. It is not the novel financial mechanism on its own.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:multi
title: Directed cross-impact shrinks the safe radius
review_note: Entrywise positive directed coupling gives monotone powers. The Kreiss-norm comparison needs its own positive-resolvent argument; arbitrary signed cross-impact is not covered.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:dich
title: Certification of linear questions
review_note: The penalized-polynomial dual and honest-interval sandwich organize all linear questions. General modulus theory is classical; verify the specialization, topology and statistical experiment. Kernel taps and noisy price responses are different observation contracts.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:parametric
title: Which questions are parametric
review_note: The l2/Hardy-space criterion is a sharp way to separate easy functionals. The written weak-compactness proof is plausible. It assumes arbitrarily deep tap observation and counts independent experiments, not total recorded time.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:philog
title: The safety question costs exactly one logarithm
review_note: A necessary logarithm is more substantial than the elementary upper bound. Inspect potential-theory proof independently; it is not fully Lean-formalized. Explicit asymptotic thresholds are extremely small, so finite-precision value comes from computed brackets.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: lem:hardy
review_note: Harmonic-measure comparison links approximation quality to coefficient norm. This is a specialist complex-analysis obligation. Numerical agreement cannot certify the analytic lower bound.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: cor:cases
title: The rates of this thesis as cases of one picture
review_note: The ladder distinguishes single taps, total feedback and full recovery. Its general-memory interpretation is explicitly heuristic; the separate Paper 1 proof establishes that rate.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: rem:energy
title: Why coefficient energy is the wrong lower-bound quantity
review_note: Refuting the earlier coefficient-energy lower bound prevents a false universal theorem. The replacement modulus measures the best approximation, not an arbitrary Taylor expansion.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:nonlinear
title: Finitely dependent questions are parametric
review_note: Finite-dimensional Lipschitz functions inherit parametric estimation through simultaneous tap error control. Infinite-horizon nonsmooth gains are not settled by this proposition.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: cor:peak
title: The peak is cheap and uninformative
review_note: The positive cohort peak equals direct impact and can be known without data even when cumulative risk varies. This is model-specific; general scalar impulse peaks can overshoot even for normal matrices.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:horizon
title: Horizon-limited amplification
review_note: Finite-horizon positive response can be certified without an infinite-memory bound. This may fit a margin period better than an infinite-horizon theorem. It is a classical sum with an economically meaningful target.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:natural
title: Natural experiments
review_note: The catch-up area equals inverse margin only for the specified shock, initialization and no further endogenous/event shock. Fundamental shocks can change memories, information and direct flow; real events need an identification design.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:overshoot
title: An overshoot certifies contrarian feedback
review_note: A sign reversal implies negative kernel terms only in this fixed positive-anchor/no-extra-shock model. Omitted depth, changing fundamentals or other channels can generate reversal without an economically contrarian cohort.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:passivecert
title: Passive certification of safety
review_note: The lower bound is transparent. A pointwise CLT or TM->infinity limit does not alone establish a fixed-constant finite-sample threshold TM>C; use the later uniform theorem and appropriate critical values.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:passivemulti
title: Passive certification with several cohorts
review_note: Finite distributed memory reduces to an augmented autoregression with one potentially critical root and others separated. It is not an unrestricted geometric-memory cohort model, and the constants grow with order/root gap.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: rem:passivecert
title: What remains open
review_note: Separates fixed-economy finite-memory results from uniform geometric-memory and nuisance-parameter problems. These distinctions belong in the abstract-level claim as well.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:drift
title: Certifying a drifting margin
review_note: The cubic-root noise/drift floor gives a meaningful reason to limit stale history. It assumes unbiased independent daily readings and a known drift bound; applying it to pooled empirical regressions requires another argument.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: cor:loopmargin
title: What the closed loop adds
review_note: The map S=kappa/M magnifies feedback error near instability. Claimed margin-independent identification is only about the spacing exponent on fixed compact families; constants can depend strongly on M.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:hidden
title: Hidden slow feedback
review_note: Arbitrarily slow hidden feedback can invalidate a finite-record stability declaration. The displayed memory-price exponent is a necessary lower bound, not a matching optimal cost. Finite-horizon loss and disclosed sensitivity bounds are different problems.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:uniformcert
title: Uniform certification with finite memory
review_note: Uniform ADF behavior depends on the exact nuisance class and cited local-to-unity theory. Pointwise explosive rejection does not by itself prove uniform size over every unstable alternative or general signed-memory process.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:pooled
title: The pooled price-and-flow estimator
review_note: Joins theory to the two regressions used in tests. Contemporaneous price noise must be independent of flow; x must be true displacement. Degenerate flow variance and singular designs need exclusion; fixed-economy limits are not finite-sample live certificates.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:absresp
title: Passive certification of worst-case loss
review_note: A horizon-limited absolute gain is the right loss object with contrarian responses. Compact stable classes support asymptotic coverage; this estimates an observable reduced form, not hidden agent identities.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:signed
title: Contrarian agents
review_note: Signed feedback can have small signed sum and unbounded absolute risk. Positive margin alone no longer decides general signed stability. Preserve the separation of linear-functional inference and absolute-gain risk.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:sector
title: Robust safety bound
review_note: Sector sensitivity plus a fixed plant gives a valid invariant box for nonlinear, changing agents. It uses a worst-case sensitivity envelope, not merely an estimated signed total; no memory floor is needed once that envelope is known.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

title: What the theorem does not cover
review_note: Plant changes, unbounded sensitivity and dynamic inventory require other bounds. Negative feedback need not be safer in realized risk; it is only dominated by this absolute-sensitivity comparison envelope.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:multiasset
title: Several assets
review_note: The induced-norm construction is transparent and conservative. It must start at rest or include a bounded initial-state term; signed positions and cross-margin require a monetary output map.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:multiasset_positive
title: Positive cross-impact comparison
review_note: A nonnegative resolvent supersolution yields a sharp class-wide bound even for nonlinear changing responses. Classical positive-system lineage remains; it does not establish arbitrary signed cross-impact stability.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:lifetime
title: Certificate lifetime
review_note: Sensitivity slack divided by learning-speed bound gives a guaranteed validity period. It is conservative, assumes the envelope is truthful, and must specify initialization/continuous maintenance at recertification.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: conj:strategic
title: Guard-consistent equilibrium
review_note: Do not leave the original existence/comparative-static conjecture looking unresolved but plausible: the discontinuous case is refuted; continuous-throttle existence is a different restricted result.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: rem:strategic_counterexample
title: Counterexample to existence under a discontinuous guard
review_note: The discontinuity counterexample shows that convex costs and compact choices do not ensure equilibrium after composition with a guard. Safety can hold without equilibrium existence.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: thm:nogaming
title: What gaming can and cannot do to the certificate
review_note: Consistency against iid independent decoy flow is not general manipulation resistance. State stationarity, memory coverage, measured executed flow and valid exogeneity. Correlated misinformation, cancellations and switching remain outside.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:throttle
title: A continuous throttle
review_note: Implicit continuous admission has a unique fixed point and bounds admitted positive feedback. Mixed existence uses standard game theory; pure existence needs quasi-concavity. Data-selected counterfactual admission needs simultaneous certificate coverage, not pointwise intervals.
revision_status: Not resolved by tests; reviewer obligation remains

label: prop:monoculture
title: Monoculture
review_note: Adoption lowers the margin only when the common strategy has stronger positive response than the displaced strategies, holding other responses fixed. Shared information can increase shock covariance; diversity is not automatically stabilizing.
revision_status: Positive-class and common-memory assumptions clarified; independent review remains
